title: Python (DEC-303): measure pyright call-hierarchy recall and precision, write the adapter ADR (adds a runtime dependency: dispatch-floor)
description: opum-doc DEC-303: glyph 0.1.0 adds Python through pyright-langserver --stdio behind a language-neutral LSP client adapter. DECIDE BEFORE BUILD: measure call-hierarchy, references and symbol recall and precision on ONE pinned real Python repository plus fixtures against a ground truth defined before pyright runs; record the pyright version; write the component ADR naming DEC-303 with the adapter design (spawn, framing, timeouts and wall-time budget, crash handling, exit 7 cases, language detection and override flag, command to LSP request mapping, stated limits); send both to opum-doc. No build code. Build slices start only after opum-doc accepts the measurement. Dispatch-floor: the eventual change adds a runtime dependency (pyright, npm), so each build slice carries an Opus review; this task itself writes an ADR and a measurement record.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the measurement runs on one pinned real Python repository plus fixtures against a ground truth committed before the first language-server request (proof: results/ground-truth-provenance.txt and results/ground-truth.bundle)
pyright version, registry integrity, node, git and host Python are recorded (proof: ADR 0008 and the artifact README)
recall and precision are reported per kind, per site and per target, with sample sizes and what the sample cannot show (proof: ADR 0008 results and limits, results/union-*.txt)
ADR 0008 names DEC-303 and holds the adapter design: client, budget, crash handling, exit 7 cases, detection and override, command mapping, limits (proof: the ADR)
no build code and no package.json or lockfile change (proof: git diff against origin/dev touches only .quest, docs and test/python-lsp-measurement)
an Opus review approves the ADR and the measurement (proof: review verdict in the notes)
opum-doc accepts the measurement and rules on D1 to D4 (proof: the ruling recorded verbatim in the notes)

definitionOfDone.text: lore check on the pinned lore 0.14.1 reports 0 errors and 0 warnings
the change lands through a pull request after the reviews

implementationNotes: 2026-11-23 Measurement and ADR written (ADR 0008, status Proposed, names DEC-303; test/python-lsp-measurement/ holds the recorded artifact). Pins: pyright 1.1.414, psf/requests 3c7baaa05ab4aa49cc819ce3a819d260de19c157, node 24.22.2, git 2.56.0, host Python 3.15.2. Ground truth committed before the first pyright request (scratch repo, 09:15:32 and 09:16:23 -06:00). Headline: incoming-call recall 58/65 (0.892, 95% Wilson 0.794-0.947) with precision 58/58; with pythonPlatform All 59/65, the six misses all constructor calls to __init__ (call hierarchy attributes them to the class); 59/59 on the other kinds; 9/9 negative targets clean; documentSymbol 298/320 (the misses are @overload stubs and win32-only defs); workspace/symbol only 43/320 when files are not open; definition-at-call-site resolved 312 in package, 648 typeshed/stdlib, 66 none of 1028. Fixtures (adversarial, not a rate): incoming 17/28, failing on aliased-import calls, constructors, a decorator application, and one non-call listed as a call; outgoingCalls finds the aliased calls (63/65 real, 21/26 fixtures). All-open runs byte-identical 6/6; open-on-demand runs not reproducible. Small sample: one 19-file annotated repository, 65 true sites; cannot separate 97% from 99.9%. Decisions for opum-doc in the ADR: D1 unresolved-site count (LSP cannot enumerate calls), D2 mixed-language repositories, D3 the recall threshold. No build code.

2026-11-23 CORRECTION on the D3 bar (leader question): incoming calls alone on the default platform are 58/65 = 0.892 (0.794-0.947), which does NOT meet the proposed bar (0.9 point, 0.8 lower bound). The quantity the design ships is the union of outgoing and incoming calls under pythonPlatform All with constructor calls recorded against their class: incoming All 59/65 = 0.908 (0.813-0.957); union 59/65 = 0.908 (0.813-0.957) (strict callee-identity match; equal to incoming on this repository, outgoing alone 57/65 = 0.877 (0.775-0.936)); with the six constructor sites found under their classes (6/6, measured as a separate class query, mapping not run end to end) 65/65 = 1.000 (lower bound 0.944). Fixtures: incoming 17/28, outgoing 20/28, union 20/28 = 0.714 (0.529-0.847), below the bar by design. The earlier note's 63/65 and 21/26 outgoing figures were a looser line-presence check, not recall, and are withdrawn. D3 is opum-doc's to rule on the bar and on which quantity it scores; the bar was not edited.

2026-11-23 REVISION after the Opus review (CHANGES) of 6bced9a. Corrections to earlier notes: the 36 targets with a true site is 37 (37 + 9 with none = 46); the sample has eight realised strata (classmethod requested, none exist); the request counts are 1,496 (52 targets) per recorded run, not 1,473; definition outcomes sum to 1,028 as 312 in package + 648 typeshed/stdlib + 2 installed package + 66 none (default platform); the earlier outgoing 63/65 and 21/26 and the first union figures were withdrawn and replaced by union.py output. New measurements committed with raw output: strict union and constructor mapping with recall AND precision per site and per target (pre-registered 46 targets: incoming 58/65 default and 59/65 All, union + ctor map 64/65 and 65/65, precision 1.000); a post-hoc alias set (4 targets, 15 sites: incoming 2/15, outgoing and union 15/15); fixtures (incoming 17/28, union + ctor map 25/28); six all-open runs byte-identical; open-on-demand runs differ from all-open in 11 of 52 targets; no Python on PATH gives identical call answers. The recall bar was proposed after the results; D3 and a new D4 (contract additions) are opum-doc's. See ADR 0008 and test/python-lsp-measurement/gt_rules_addendum.md.

2026-11-23 ROUND 2 revision after the second Opus review (CHANGES): the platform channel is now measured (LSP settings do not reach pyright; a config file does, including one outside the repository: results/platform-channels.txt); the bar table adds cluster-robust intervals (incoming All lower bound 0.788, below 0.8; the shipped union + constructor mapping 37/37 target-level lower 0.906, labelled an in-sample fit); the definition check uses exact def spans (64/65, 65/65); the design states partial-index, unreachable-code, decorator, constructor-mapping and unattributed-edge handling; D2 to D4 now carry options and a recommendation; ground-truth.bundle committed.

2026-11-23 CORRECTION (round 3): note 2's fixture figures for outgoing and the union (20/28) are superseded by union.py on the committed raw output: outgoing and union are 21/28, union + ctor map 25/28 (results/union-fx-default.txt, -allplat.txt). Round 3 additions: the shipped analysis-root layout was scored (requests 65/65 under all three layouts, results/layouts.txt) and an absolute-import fixture showed 0/5 with an out-of-repository root unless extraPaths is set (5/5 with it); definition-at-site check deduplicated (fixtures 18/18 checked, 8 lines not checkable by name); design text now carries one constructor rule (MRO, plain classes), a decorator rule, a fail-closed rule for unreachable code, and per-answer note in D4.
